svg.text: Ingress — one ALB in front of every service
APPLICATION LOAD BALANCER — created by the controller, not by you
listener :443 TLS terminated with an ACM certificate
PRIVATE SUBNETS — no public IPs anywhere below this line
The ALB targets pod IPs directly. A failing readiness probe deregisters that pod from the ALB target group
within seconds — the health-aware routing from Module 03, now driven by the pod itself.
